_meta.source: TB_AI_Audit_Final_Detailed_Team_Final.md sec 8.1 (provisional materiality proxies), sec 2.2 (materiality by value/nature/context)
_meta.purpose: Benchmark percentages and threshold fractions for PROVISIONAL planning materiality, plus the sensitive-item floors that make an account material by NATURE regardless of value.
_meta.extraction_note: benchmark_percentages / threshold_fractions / priority_ratios / distribution_ratios / coverage_thresholds are generated from the Python literals by AST read and reproduce current behaviour exactly. sensitive_floors is NEW (sec 8.1) and is NOT read by build_materiality -- it is consumed by build_materiality_lens, which layers nature/context beside the existing quantitative waterfall without modifying it.
_meta.amend_policy: Audit-approved materiality, when the engagement team supplies one, OVERRIDES everything here. These are proxies for prioritisation only and must be labelled provisional in output -- sec 8.1.

sensitive_floors._note: sec 8.1 sensitive-item floor and sec 2.2 materiality by nature/context. An account matching one of these sensitive tags is elevated for audit attention even when its value sits below the clearly-trivial threshold. floor_fraction is expressed as a fraction of OVERALL materiality: 0.0 means any non-nil balance qualifies.

grant_subsidy.reason: Public money with purpose restriction -- regularity and utilisation apply at any value (sec 12.3).

propriety.reason: Write-off, waiver, ex-gratia, loss or shortage requires competent sanction regardless of amount (sec 2.2, sec 12.4).

related_party.reason: Disclosure completeness does not have a value threshold (sec 11).

csr.reason: Section 135 computation and unspent-account treatment are statutory (sec 9.17).

suspense_control.reason: Unresolved classification; can mask offsetting errors far larger than the net balance (sec 12.1).

msme.reason: Delayed-payment interest and disclosure are statutory (sec 10.1).

prior_period_item.reason: Indicates a correction whose origin period needs explanation (sec 9.15).

foreign_currency.reason: Restatement at closing rate and exchange-difference treatment (sec 9.15).
